text:
Ava: Quick sync on compact 'lift-and-shift' on-prem packaging. Goals: minimal agent (no k8s), explicit customer-managed egress modes, in-place upgrade <=2m p95 downtime, and airgap installer. Objections by EOD please.

Sam: Phase 1 question: support source-IP preservation or SNAT-only? Some customers need preserved egress IP.

Priya: Launch criteria draft: pilot at 2 customers (one NAT, one IP-preserved), operator smoke tests green, docs + rollback playbook published, telemetry opt-in and privacy sign-off. No admin API schema changes at launch.

Diego: Packaging note: offline installer = single tar.gz + detached sha256+GPG sig. Installer will verify sig, disk, and user before extracting. Example: `gpg --verify agent.tar.gz.sig agent.tar.gz`.

Sam: Define network modes: DIRECT (customer routes to agent), RELAY (customer proxy), RELAY+PIN (proxy + egress pinning). Different rollback semantics per mode.

Lewis: KMS/HSM: airgap installs must accept encrypted key blobs and support local rotation. Acceptance: import->sign->rotate->verify offline.

Emma: Rollout plan: canary 5% -> 25% -> 100% with auto-rollback if p50 latency +200ms or error rate >0.5%. Include fallback to hosted-compatible model variant.

Ava: Example config for docs:
```
mode = "agent"
egress = { type = "relay", address = "relay.example.local:443" }
upgrade_window = "2m"
telemetry = { enabled = false }
```

Priya: Security will block launch if telemetry is not opt-in or signatures are unverifiable.

Diego: Action items: offline-installer spec + sig flow, `install.sh` stub to validate sig+disk.

Emma: Contract note: rollback SLA <1h for major upgrades; ops automation needed.

Ava: Owners: Priya -> launch criteria & security; Diego -> installer spec; Lewis -> KMS tests; Sam -> network diagrams & cheat sheet; Emma -> rollout runbook. Field-pilot sync Mon 10am.

ops-bot: PR #4823 created by Diego: add-offline-installer-spec :white_check_mark:

Sam: NetCorp request: deterministic upgrade ordering across 4 edge proxies + source-IP preservation. Add to pilot acceptance.

Ava: Added NetCorp to pilot candidates.

Emma: Who owns rollback doc?

Ava: Emma owns rollout steps; Priya owns security/playbook; Sam owns network diagrams.

Sam: Will draft diagrams and one-pager. :+1:

Ava: If no objections by EOD we'll lock scope and open RFC. :shipit:
